title: Bank Deposit Terms of Cancellation
content:
Only the customer can cancel their own Bank Deposit transfer. The agent explains what will be refunded, and the customer confirms the cancellation.

## When a transfer can be cancelled

1. A transfer can be cancelled while it is awaiting funds or on hold.
2. A released transfer (in transit) can be cancelled only on a tier whose terms make it cancellable in transit, and only until the beneficiary bank credits it. The status and the tier are read from the transfer record.
3. A deposited transfer can never be cancelled; what remains for it is an error notice under the Remittance Transfer Rule or a recall.

## What is refunded on cancellation

4. A fee is refunded in full on cancellation only when the customer confirms the cancellation within the tier's full-refund window of elapsed hours after the transfer was booked. The window is measured in elapsed hours from the booking moment to the cancellation moment, and a cancellation at exactly the end of the window is inside it.
5. Inside the window, every fee collected is refunded, with the refund reason "cancellation within the window".
6. After the window, each fee collected (transfer fee, card funding fee, OUR surcharge) is refunded at the tier's after-window share of its amount, rounded half up to the cent, when the transfer was cancelled from awaiting funds or on hold, and is not refunded at all when it was cancelled from in transit. These refunds carry the refund reason "cancellation after the window".
7. The principal is always refunded in full under the Bank Deposit principal refund rules.
8. Money not yet collected, such as an ACH debit not yet settled, is simply not collected.
9. Each fee charge is refunded at most once.

## Outcome table

| Status cancelled from | Cancellation moment | Fees refunded |
|---|---|---|
| Awaiting funds or on hold | within the window (end included) | every fee in full |
| Awaiting funds or on hold | after the window | each fee at the tier's after-window share, rounded half up to the cent |
| In transit (tier cancellable in transit) | within the window (end included) | every fee in full |
| In transit (tier cancellable in transit) | after the window | none |

## Worked cases (hypothetical times and amounts, tier window of 0.50 hours)

- Booked at 10:00:00, cancellation confirmed at 10:30:00: exactly the end of the window, so inside it; every fee is refunded in full.
- Booked at 10:00:00, cancellation confirmed at 10:30:01: after the window.
- A Bank Deposit Express Plus transfer on hold, cancelled after the window, whose after-window share is 50 percent: a transfer fee of 4.49 is refunded at 2.245, rounded half up to 2.25; a card funding fee of 45.00 is refunded at 22.50.
- A Bank Deposit Standard transfer in transit cancelled two hours after booking: no fee is refunded; the principal is refunded in full.
